|lore=Smuggler, gambler and “freelance law-bender.” Crafty Corellian pirate. Rebel hero. Owns ''Millennium Falcon''. Co-pilot Chewbacca promised him “life-debt.” Has bounty on head.
|game_text=Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots (4 if ''Falcon''). Cards with “Han” in title are destiny +3. May use 1 Force to cancel Boba Fett or Jabba’s game text for remainder of turn. If opponent just initiated a battle here, may use 1 Force to take the first weapons segment action.

|notes=The [[Han Solo (V) (Virtual Set 10: Fourth Anthology) (Original 2005)|2005 original wording]] survives in the recovered publisher sheet. The original allows a payment during the opponent’s turn to grant the first weapons action in battles at Han’s location for the remainder of that turn. The remaster makes the payment a response when the opponent just initiated a battle here and grants the first weapons action for that battle. The Han-title destiny bonus and the 1 Force game-text cancellation remain. [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/download/file.php?id=16603#page=1 Players Committee original sheet, p. 1, slip 4]. [[:File:VS10O-04-Han_Solo.png|Publisher slip]]. [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards10.pdf#page=2 Players Committee remastered sheet, p. 2, slip 4]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154531id_/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards10.pdf#page=2 Internet Archive].
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154531/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards10.pdf#page=2 VirtualCards10.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 2, slip 04.
